text: I cannot diagnose migraine in a 2-day-old infant presenting with bilious vomiting and failure to pass meconium, as these are classic signs of a surgical abdominal emergency like Hirschsprung disease. I will request further tests to confirm the correct diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Contrast_Enema

text: The normal contrast enema makes Hirschsprung disease less likely, so I need to rule out other causes of intestinal obstruction. REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_Ultrasound

text: Given the normal imaging results despite clear signs of distal obstruction, I suspect a mechanical cause like meconium ileus, which is strongly associated with Cystic Fibrosis. REQUEST TEST: Sweat_Chloride_Test
